## Identity & Core Proposition
- Name: CredSmart by CredAlert
- Website: https://pos.credalert.bussiness/
- Product Type: All-in-One Business Management & GST Billing Software
- Pricing: 100% Completely Free Forever — No software fees, no credit card, no trial limits, no hidden charges.
- Parent Platform: CredAlert (Commercial Credit Risk & Counterparty Intelligence Network - https://www.credalert.business)
- Target Audience: Indian Retailers, Wholesalers, Distributors, Kirana Stores, Pharmacies, Manufacturers, and MSMEs.

## Core Capabilities
1. Official GST Invoicing & Billing:
   - Full CGST, SGST, IGST support with automatic state-based tax split.
   - A4 Professional tax invoices and high-speed Thermal POS receipts (58mm, 80mm ESC/POS).
   - Dynamic UPI Payment QR codes generated directly on invoices for instant collection.
   - GSTR-1 ready Excel & JSON exports for Chartered Accountants.

2. High-Speed Retail POS Counter:
   - Barcode scanning with ultra-fast SKU resolution (< 50ms).
   - Up to 5 concurrent held bills with instant 1-click retrieval.
   - Keyboard shortcuts (F1-F12), cash tender change calculator, and multi-mode payment splits.

3. Inventory & Multi-Godown Warehouse Management:
   - Real-time stock tracking across multiple retail counters and storage godowns.
   - Batch numbers, manufacturing & expiry date tracking.
   - Automated low-stock alerts and out-of-stock prevention.

4. Customer Udhar Khata & Party Ledgers:
   - Digital credit ledger for customer receivables.
   - Running debit/credit balances with instant WhatsApp payment reminder links.

5. CredSmart Business Ecosystem:
   - Inter-business automated invoicing: When Business A creates a sales invoice in CredSmart, it automatically flows into Business B's purchase ledger.
   - Eliminates duplicate data entry and tax credit mismatch.

6. CredAlert Commercial Credit Risk Intelligence:
   - Automatic counterparty risk warnings before extending commercial credit.
   - Verified database of MCA-registered companies and commercial payment track records.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is CredSmart really 100% free forever?
A: Yes. All features — POS billing, GST invoicing, inventory, customer khata, reports — are completely free without trial expiration.

Q: Can CredSmart run on mobile phones?
A: Yes. CredSmart is a modern responsive Progressive Web App that runs seamlessly on smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.
